context: Whole group hosts a small picnic-concert with friends; many voices.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: The plaza's really come together—everyone's here!
lines.style: Warm, open-armed energy from the start. Soft Kansai lilt. Genuine pleasure in the gathering, no performance. Steady, comfortable pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: みなさん、ようこそ、ピクニックコンサート!
lines.en: Welcome, everyone, to our picnic concert!
lines.style: Gracious, hosting from the heart. Bright but not forced. The kind of warmth that makes people feel actually seen, not performed-for. Slight lift at the end, inclusive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 心、ようけ、繋がるね、こうやって。
lines.en: It's something, isn't it—so many hearts connected like this.
lines.style: Quiet wonder underneath. Pause before the observation, like she's feeling it while saying it. Tender, not effusive. Slow, almost hesitant—like she's noticing something true.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 関わる皆さんに、感謝の気持ち。
lines.en: I'm grateful to everyone who made this possible.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Not distant—close enough to feel the sincerity. Steady, calm tone. A young man who means what he says and doesn't oversell it.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: こんな広場、徐々に賑やかになったな!
lines.en: The plaza used to be so quiet—look at it now, all this life!
lines.style: Boisterous warmth with an undertone of genuine pride. Kansai energy but not loud—generous, animated. The satisfaction of seeing something grow. Slight laugh in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: You can feel how much it's changed since the old days.
lines.style: Quietly reflective. The voice of someone watching time do its work. Measured, patient—no rush. Soft Kansai warmth. The words carry the weight of having seen it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Being here with everyone—this is the best!
lines.style: Pure, unselfconscious joy. Bright, immediate. A small boy who feels the moment fully and has no reason to hide it. Open-hearted, almost bouncing with happiness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 音楽、もう少しで始まるで!
lines.en: Music's about to start—won't be long now!
lines.style: Building anticipation, like he can feel it in the air. Warm, infectious energy. Kansai directness with genuine excitement. Slight forward lean in the delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Thank you all for being here. My heart feels so full.
lines.style: Tender gratitude, slightly overwhelmed in the best way. Warm, genuine. Softer than the hosting voice—more intimate, less performance. Slight catch, like emotion settling in.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 記事に書きたい、こんな日。
lines.en: Days like this—I want to write about them.
lines.style: Soft, committed. The voice of someone who sees meaning in the moment and knows she needs to capture it. Earnest without being heavy. Slight reverential tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Meeting all of you—that's a real treasure.
lines.style: Tender, thoughtful. No rush. The words chosen carefully. Soft Kansai warmth underneath. A young man saying something sincere and meaning it completely, without awkwardness.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: うちのお店も、こうやって、繋がる!
lines.en: Even my shop feels part of this, part of all of you.
lines.style: Warm, generous Kansai pride. Animated but grounded. The tone of someone who's built something and sees it connecting to something larger. Slightly victorious, wholly unpretentious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: It's a good town when everyone's here together like this.
lines.style: Deep satisfaction, quiet and certain. The voice of someone who has seen much and knows quality when he's standing in it. Slow, measured. Kansai warmth, but sparing with words—each one counts.
